title: Resolve every implementation testing witness to an identified Bun test

values: implementation source declaring a testing witness
facts.note: Proposed observer requirement: something must extract testing-witness declarations from implementation sources. The source only names the validator atdd_traceability_closure; its extraction capability is not established by the source.
Proposed observer requirement: a finding that a declared witness does not resolve to an identified Bun test. Whether atdd_traceability_closure emits such a finding is not stated in the source.

fires: Any implementation source in the repository (changed or not) declares a testing witness that names a test not present among the Bun tests.
A Bun test referenced by an implementation testing witness has been renamed, moved or deleted so the witness no longer resolves.
A testing witness points to a test that cannot be uniquely identified.
doesNotFire: An implementation source declares no testing witness (that absence is governed by traceability.source.tested-by-present).
Every implementation testing witness in the repository resolves to an identified Bun test.

given: An implementation source declares one or more testing witnesses
when: the implementation testing witnesses are checked for resolution (at any time, regardless of which files changed)
then: Each implementation testing witness must resolve to an identified Bun test.
prefer: Point each testing witness at a concrete, identified Bun test that exists, and update the witness in the same change when that test is renamed or moved.
avoid: Leaving a testing witness that names a missing, renamed or ambiguous test.
Creating placeholder or empty tests only so a witness resolves (metric gaming).
why: Implementation-to-test links chain with test-to-plan links into plan→test→implementation closure; a dangling witness breaks that chain.
evidence: The atdd_traceability_closure validator passes for the implementation testing witnesses.
For each testing witness, the referenced Bun test can be located and uniquely identified.
verifier_detail: Strict disposition: any unresolved witness is a failure (see shared:policy.strict-disposition).

Scope is all implementation testing witnesses, not only those in changed files; pre-existing unresolved witnesses are in scope. Resolution target is any Bun test, irrespective of the test file's language.
Requires traceability.source.tested-by-present first (a witness can only resolve once declared); runs alongside traceability.test.binding-resolves.

sharedNodes.text: strict: fails on every finding, no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: the implementation testing witnesses are checked for resolution (at any time, regardless of which files changed)
additions.justification: Source has no explicit trigger; the statement is universal, so the when is a neutral, unrestricted check event rather than a change-only condition.

additions.text: Creating placeholder or empty tests only so a witness resolves (metric gaming).
additions.justification: Required metric-gaming anti-pattern; not stated in the source.

additions.text: Implementation-to-test links chain with test-to-plan links into plan→test→implementation closure.
additions.justification: Source has no rationale; derived from graph.json edge (runs_alongside traceability.test.binding-resolves).

additions.text: Facts (marked as proposed observer requirements), fires and doesNotFire cases including the boundary with traceability.source.tested-by-present.
additions.justification: Source has no activation; derived from the statement and graph.json requires edge.

additions.text: Update the witness in the same change when the referenced test is renamed or moved.
additions.justification: Concrete move implied by the statement; not stated in the source.
